name: futureflow
description: AI 工作流平台 - FlowGram 画布 + 自研网关 + 无头 Dify

scripts.dev: pnpm run gateway & pnpm run frontend
scripts.env:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto');if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){let env=fs.readFileSync('.env.example','utf8');env=env.replace('DIFY_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET=replace-with-a-random-secret-at-least-32-characters','DIFY_KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET='+crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'));fs.writeFileSync('.env',env,{mode:0o600});console.log('.env created with a local Dify credential-encryption secret')}else{console.log('.env already exists')}"
scripts.quickstart: pnpm run env:init && pnpm install --prod=false && pnpm run start
scripts.test:platform: pnpm --filter futureflow-gateway test:smoke && pnpm --filter futureflow-gateway test:integration
scripts.verify: pnpm run ts-check && pnpm run test:platform && pnpm run build:gateway && pnpm run build:frontend
